_comment: Blocks legacy authentication protocols (basic auth, IMAP, POP, older Office clients) that don't support modern auth / MFA — a documented, common initial-access vector since legacy protocols can't be challenged for MFA at all.
_deployment_note: clientAppTypes 'other' covers legacy/basic-auth clients Graph groups under that label. Report-only first, same reasoning as CA001 — legacy auth is often still in use by a forgotten service account or an old scanner/printer, and finding that out via a hard block is a bad way to find out.
